_comment: What check-file-hygiene.mjs must not read, or must not apply its house-style
tier to, in THIS repository. The CHECKER lives in claude-skills
(tools/check-file-hygiene.mjs) so that all three repositories can run it
without a token; the RULE travels and these exemptions stay home, because a
checker three repositories run must not carry one repository's exclusion
list. buses-data OA-241 states the convention; this file arrived with OA-398.
TWO DECLARATIONS, FOR TWO CORPORA, BY TWO DIFFERENT MECHANISMS. They landed
four days apart and neither supersedes the other, so both entries stay and the
reason for each is written beside it rather than shared.
neverRead, over gate-fixtures/. Until 2026-09-18 this repository declared
nothing and got the bare rules over its whole tracked corpus, which was right
and cost nothing. Vendoring the byte gates' fixtures into gate-fixtures/
changed that: 45 of the 73 files are generator output with no final newline,
and they are BYTE-IDENTICAL COPIES of files in buses-data, which excuses the
same folder for the same reason. Fixing them here would make the copy differ
from its source and turn `npm run fixtures:vendor` red for ever; excusing them
keeps the copy honest. The pattern is buses-data's own, so the same fixture is
excused by the same words on both sides of the copy.
notAuthored, over scripts/fixtures/. These are not copies of another
repository's files but captures of the engine's own output, taken off the map
tree so that the halves of test-build-warnings.mjs and test-complexity-band.mjs
which need real engine output can run in CI rather than on one laptop.
ONLY TIER 2 IS RELAXED by that second entry. A byte-order mark and mixed line
endings are still findings in a captured file, and must be: those are the two
faults that would make a fixture differ from what the engine wrote in a way no
diff shows.
notAuthored: verbatim engine output, captured off the map tree in buses-data and committed unchanged — the whole value of a captured fixture is that its bytes are the engine's, so adding a final newline here would make it our file rather than its. scripts/fixtures/README.md says where each one came from
